say:1:1360002001:1.text: Phew, thanks for catching it. I thought it was going to get away!
say:1:1360002001:1.source_cn: 呼，太好了，多亏你们截住了，差点还以为让它跑了呢。

say:2:1360002002:1.text: Hello, everyone! It's been a while!

say:4:1360002003:0.text: Hi, Marilee! Long time no see. But what is that thing? Why are you chasing it?

say:7:1360002006:1.text: I've encountered it a few times over the past few days. It's definitely alive, but it's super slippery and doesn't fight back. When you beat it, it drops coins and then takes off!
say:7:1360002006:1.source_cn: 总之，这几天我跟它战斗过几次。它确实是活的，神出鬼没，...

say:9:1360002007:0.text: That sounds amazing! Like money falling from the sky! Could this mean Dura is finally revealing herself?

say:10:1360002008:1.text: Before anyone can respond, a voice cuts through the excitement.

say:13:1360002009:1.text: It's not directly tied to the goddess, but it does have a divine touch.
say:13:1360002009:1.source_cn: 虽然和女神没有直接的关系，但也算是和神明有一定关系的特...

say:14:1360002010:1.text: Dionel? What are you doing all the way out here?
say:14:1360002010:1.source_cn: 萨、萨基塔里斯大人？你怎么会突然来这荒郊野外……

say:15:1360002011:0.text: It's lucky satchel season! I came to oversee the event and just happened to stumble upon all of you.
say:15:1360002011:0.source_cn: 最近是聚财招福袋活动的周期，本来想出来处理下，没想到遇...

say:16:1360002012:1.text: Well, that's unexpected. Don't tell me even a Celestial can't resist a heavenly treasure.
say:16:1360002012:1.source_cn: 哟，没想到呀，难道高贵的半神大人也舍不得这天降的财宝？

say:17:1360002013:1.text: Haha, relax, I'm not here to claim your spoils. Actually, let me fill you in a bit.
say:17:1360002013:1.source_cn: 哈哈，放心吧，我不会抢夺你们的机会，相反，我可以为你们...

say:19:1360002014:0.text: Your grandmother's name for it is spot on—it's called a lucky satchel.
say:19:1360002014:0.source_cn: 这个小姑娘的祖母——以及祖母的祖母留下的名字没错，它的...

say:20:1360002015:1.text: It only appears during the <style="highlight">Emberlight Festival</style>, gathering joy and laughter from the past year and turning it into the coins it carries.
say:20:1360002015:1.source_cn: 它只会在每年的<style=highlight>春焰庆...

say:21:1360002016:1.text: Most of the time, they only show up in <style="highlight">dreams</style>, but when the world is filled with happiness and prosperity, they appear for real.
say:21:1360002016:1.source_cn: 大部分时候，它们只会出现在<style=highlig...

say:22:1360002017:1.text: Defeat one, and it offers its coins as a blessing of wealth.
say:22:1360002017:1.source_cn: 只需要击败它们，它们就会把钱币吐出来作为财富的馈赠与祝福。

say:24:1360002018:0.text: So, the happier people are, the fuller the bag gets?
say:24:1360002018:0.source_cn: 也就是说，大家越幸福，这个袋子里面就会越满了？

say:25:1360002019:0.text: Exactly. But if the world's been through hardship or sorrow, like after a long war, the satchels become weak and shriveled, leaving no gifts behind.
say:25:1360002019:0.source_cn: 是的，如果世间太过混乱或悲伤，比如经历了漫长的战争，它...

say:26:1360002020:0.text: Since they're born from the magic of dreams, they'll keep showing up as long as that magic lingers.
say:26:1360002020:0.source_cn: 因为是梦境中诞生的神奇力量，所以也会不断出现。

say:27:1360002021:0.text: The one you just caught was brimming with energy, so you should see it again soon.

say:29:1360002022:0.text: Wait, so we can just catch them whenever we want? And everything inside is ours?
say:29:1360002022:0.source_cn: 也就是说，我们可以随便捉住它？然后里面的财富就都归我们了？

say:37:1360002029:1.source_cn: 不过今年有了聚财招福袋，应该会更宽裕，我打算也去买点烟...

say:38:1360002030:0.text: Fireworks for the family? That sounds delightful. I wouldn't miss it.
say:38:1360002030:0.source_cn: 哦？要办庆典吗？那我可不能错过。
